WoW: Forever

Shaman

Forever's Shaman changes are mostly upkeep: weapon imbues last an hour instead of five minutes, totems last five minutes and reach thirty yards, and a totem bar drops four at once.

WoW: Forever · Updated October 5, 2026 · Beta build 1.60.1.70124 · Null Ossuary

Written for levelling, 1 to 60. Forever's beta is capped at level 30 as of the October 1 build, which Blizzard raised from 20 that day, so no level-60 Shaman build has been tested. One fact below is single-sourced and contradicts vanilla, that Shaman learn mail at 40 rather than wearing it from level 1. We have flagged it in place. Alliance Shaman are new in Forever, and Dwarf is the only Alliance option.

Two facts that will save you a mistake. Shamans cannot dual wield in Forever, if you have played a later expansion, unlearn that. And a widely-published level-30 Elemental build is not legal on the current client: it spends 5 points on Elemental FuryElemental FuryTalentCastInstantIncreases the critical strike damage bonus of your Searing and Magma Totems and your Fire, Frost, and Nature spells by 100%., which Blizzard moved to row 6 on September 24, putting it out of reach at 21 points. That build predates the change.

A note on Enhancement tanking. You will see it discussed, usually pointing at Spirit WeaponsSpirit WeaponsTalentCastInstantGives a chance to parry enemy melee attacks, reduces all threat generated by your attacks by 30% while Rockbiter Weapon is not active, and increases all threat generated by 30% while Rockbiter Weapon is active.. There is no Blizzard statement either way, no published tanking build, and the three positions in circulation disagree. Three tanks — Protection Warrior, Protection Paladin and Feral Druid — is the common assumption, not a Blizzard taxonomy: its Druid deep dive credits Druids with the "ability to serve any combat role", and its Hunter deep dive has pets tanking "in solo and small group play." Treat Shaman tanking as an experiment, not a plan.

Is Shaman for you?

Play Shaman if you want one character that can heal, cast at range or fight in melee, and you do not mind four class quests gating your totems on the way up.

Strengths

  • Heals, ranged damage and melee, all from one character
  • Totems buff the whole party, and now last 5 minutes and reach 30 yards
  • Ghost WolfGhost WolfLevel 20 · Spell · NatureCast3 sec castCost100 ManaDurationUntil cancelledTurns the Shaman into a Ghost Wolf, increasing speed by 40%. Only useable outdoors. at 20 gives 40% run speed, twenty levels before a mount

Weaknesses

  • Mana pays for everything, including every totem you drop
  • Four class quests gate your totems, and one is a two-hour trek
  • No taunt, no defensive cooldown, and no dual wield in Forever

New to this class?

Is the rotation simple? A weapon imbue, Lightning ShieldLightning ShieldLevel 8 · Spell · NatureCastInstantCost45 ManaDuration600 secThe caster is surrounded by 3 balls of lightning. When a spell, melee or ranged attack hits the caster, the attacker will be struck for 13 Nature damage. This expends one lightning ball. Only one ball will fire every few seconds. Lasts 600 sec., totems, a shock, then swing.

Is it forgiving? You heal yourself, and ReincarnationReincarnationLevel 30 · Spell · NatureCastInstantCooldown3600 sec cooldownAllows you to resurrect yourself upon death with 20% health and mana. at 30 is a self-resurrect — though mail may not arrive until 40.

What carries you while levelling? A weapon imbue now lasts an hour instead of five minutes, so a pull costs you nothing but a totem drop.

Does it need a group? No. Each spec can cast, swing and heal itself; the spec pages carry the published levelling ratings and what they measure.

Which race

Read this section in proportion. Race is the smallest of the choices on this page, well behind spec, gear and knowing your rotation, and no race is a wrong answer for levelling (ours, not a source's). Where racials genuinely decide things is PvP, and specifically the ones that break crowd control: Will of the ForsakenWill of the ForsakenTalentCastInstantCooldown120 sec cooldownInstantly removes all Charm, Fear and Sleep effects. (Undead, fear, sleep and charm), Escape ArtistEscape ArtistTalentCastInstantCooldown120 sec cooldownDuration3 secInstantly escape the effects of any movement impairing effect and gain immunity to those effects for 3 sec. (Gnome, roots and snares) and StoneformStoneformTalentCastInstantCooldown30 sec cooldownDuration15 secIncreases the caster's armor by 20 for 15 sec. (Dwarf, bleeds, poisons and disease). A free trinket slot is worth more than any damage racial below.

Alliance — Dwarf, and it is forced, being the only Alliance Shaman. It is fine anyway: StoneformStoneformTalentCastInstantCooldown30 sec cooldownDuration15 secIncreases the caster's armor by 20 for 15 sec. is a real solo cooldown, and Mace SpecializationMace SpecializationTalentCastInstantDurationUntil cancelledIncreases your damage with One-Handed Maces by 1. gives +1% crit to spells and abilities merely for holding a mace, which Shaman train by default, so it is free crit for Elemental and Restoration too.

Horde — Orc. Blood FuryBlood FuryTalentCastInstantCooldown120 sec cooldownDuration15 secIncreases Attack Power and Spell Power by 10% for 15 sec. now gives +10% attack power and spell power, so it is good for both damage specs.

Tauren is newly competitive, because EnduranceEnduranceTalentCastInstantReduces the cooldown of your Sprint and Evasion abilities by 60%. now adds +1% hit alongside its health. Horde's other new option is Skyborne — Wind BlessedWind BlessedTalentCastInstantIncreases your spellcasting, melee, and ranged Haste by 1%. is a flat +1% haste to melee, ranged and spellcasting alike, and Elemental InsightElemental InsightTalentCastInstantDamage dealt versus Elementals increased by 5%. adds +5% damage against Elemental-type enemies, so both apply whichever spec you play. Do not pick it for mobility, though, a tester established that SkysightSkysightTalentCast0.5 sec castCooldown120 sec cooldownAttempt to draw power from a convergence of elements and receive its blessing, increasing your movement and mounted movement speeds by 10%. Lasts 30 sec if no elemental convergence is nearby, and 900 sec if one is found. does not stack with any movement ability, and the author of the guide that claimed otherwise conceded the point.

Quality of life

  • The four totem class quests are mandatory and they gate the class. You cannot use any totem of an element until you finish its quest, and each gives you a physical totem item you must keep in your bags. Earth at 4, Fire at 10, Water at 20, Air at 30. The Alliance water chain is new content and takes roughly two hours of running, at least you have Ghost WolfGhost WolfLevel 20 · Spell · NatureCast3 sec castCost100 ManaDurationUntil cancelledTurns the Shaman into a Ghost Wolf, increasing speed by 40%. Only useable outdoors. by then.
  • Do not assume dual wield. No Forever source grants it to Shaman, and one guide explicitly declines to infer it from a removed talent. An Enhancement leveller also does not want a shield: Shield SpecializationShield SpecializationTalentCastInstantDurationUntil cancelledIncreases your chance to block attacks with a shield by 1% and increases the amount blocked by 5%. was removed from the tree, so nothing pays for one.
  • Mail armour at 40, not level 1, this is single-sourced and contradicts vanilla, so verify it in game. If it holds, you are a leather-wearer for 39 levels.
  • The Legacy perk PermanencePermanenceTalentCastInstantYour class abilities which grant long-duration stat or attribute benefits to all party or raid members last 100% longer, and the benefits you gain from resting at a camp last 50% longer. doubles long buffs, which reads directly onto totems, five minutes becomes ten.

At level 60

Unknown. No source publishes a Shaman build past 30, and nobody has seen the level-30 Air totem quest. On Enhancement tanking, the threat talents are real — Spirit WeaponsSpirit WeaponsTalentCastInstantGives a chance to parry enemy melee attacks, reduces all threat generated by your attacks by 30% while Rockbiter Weapon is not active, and increases all threat generated by 30% while Rockbiter Weapon is active. swings threat by 30% depending on your imbue, but the role claim is not supported, and Shaman has no taunt, no defensive cooldown and no Defense support. Raids open December 9.
